label: early trigram: (b/w/z/0/s) z X at original position 2-3, plus diffuse copy-phase firing
explanation: Very sparse, weak feature (mean act 0.125, max 0.22). Component 1 (about 38% of mass): original-phase steps t=2-3 where the previous input is z, the token before that is one of b/w/z/0/s (usually the first token), and the current input is one of i/l/q/h/o/c/u/2/0; dev P=0.39 R=0.37. Component 2 (about 37% of mass): copy-phase steps spread across recall positions, often when the re-fed input is i (also h, l, p) after r/a/k, especially around recall_idx 3-4 and the final step of L=9 sequences; I could not find a precise predicate for it (adding (phase==2)&(in_tok==i)&recall_idx in {3,4} raises recall to 0.47 but drops precision to 0.03). Never fires at t=0-1, almost never on the delimiter or after copying goes wrong. Magnitude is not clearly modulated by any variable I checked.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: t=2 & prev_tok=z (+6.49), phase=2 & in_tok=h (+4.41), t=3 & prev_tok=z (+4.40), in_tok=l (+3.37), recall_idx=-1 & in_tok=q (+3.12), in_tok=i (+3.05). Lower it: recall_idx=1 (-3.32), orig_idx=-1 (-2.34), in_tok=z (-2.34), L=9 & recall_idx=-1 (-2.33).
